briefing: Doris Matsui is the Democrat running for the House in California's district 7. The campaign has raised $3.19M and has $467K in the bank. Outside groups have spent $267K to help and $140K to attack. Campaign health reads 55 out of 100, stable against Kathryn S Ming. Strongest on money, weakest on activity. Liabilities cost 6 points of that: debt larger than cash. Ledger Score is 79, some flags. The biggest flag: Reliance on PAC money. $937K from PACs and other committees, 29% of $3.19M raised.
